Chapter 1369 - 1: The Myriad Realms Gate’S Transformation

Chapter 1369: Chapter 1: The Myriad Realms Gate’s Transformation

A favor from a time being is immensely valuable, especially for these special entities.

But because of his shortsightedness, thinking Lin Yuan might not break through the time loop, he was eager to use that favor before it went to waste.

Now it seems... the Eye of Myriad Laws regrets it deeply.

The special entities have lived through long cosmic eras, even witnessing the birth of time beings one after another.

They know that the commotion caused by Lin Yuan stepping into the Thirteenth Realm far exceeds that made by other time beings in the past.

This result means that Lin Yuan’s strength and potential are stronger than other time beings.

Yet this kind of favor was used up by him like this? The Eye of Myriad Laws felt utterly helpless.

With Lin Yuan’s current strength, trying to further the relationship is almost impossible now.

...

In the depths of the dim space-time, a figure sat cross-legged.

It was Lin Yuan.

After stepping into the Thirteenth Realm and enduring the Chaos Void Origin Infusion, Lin Yuan’s true self had become the strongest.

As for the second source world, the true self enriched by the legacy of the Lord of Heaven Light? To reach the level of the Chaos Void true self would still require completely refining those two crystals.

"My internal universe is probably about one percent of the size of the Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan observed his internal universe; he was still at the initial stage of the Thirteenth Realm and hadn’t grown to the limit.

Lin Yuan predicted that once he reached his peak, his internal universe would achieve a tenth of the Chaos Void’s size.

A tenth of the Chaos Void? It’s known that the Chaos Void is the pinnacle of dimensional space; even a ten-thousandth or a millionth of it is endless for beings below the Thirteenth Realm, impossible to explore fully in their lifetime.

"If I step into the Second Realm of the Thirteenth Realm, my internal universe might directly rival the Chaos Void."

Lin Yuan thought to himself. Now he was just a newly ascended time being, having only entered the First Realm. Awaiting his entrance into the Second Realm, there’d be another significant enhancement.

At that time, his internal universe would thoroughly rival the Chaos Void.

This is also what Lord Mo Xu’s "Infinite Void" theory describes.

It’s what Lord Mo Xu has pursued throughout the ages.

Unlike Lin Yuan, once the "Infinite Void" reaches this level, it’s the limit, approaching the Time Lord.

However, Lin Yuan’s internal universe, even if it reaches the he size comparable to the Chaos Void, hasn’t reached the ultimate goal; it can still continue to ascend.

With the fusion of two source world’s essential operations, Lin Yuan’s internal universe possesses an aura of perfection, its potential so vast, it may approach the possibility of a truly perfect world.

"I’m almost familiar with the Thirteenth Realm time being’s methods."

Lin Yuan stood up, his gaze profound.

The Thirteenth Realm time beings have more than just the means to observe future timelines.

The essence of life at this level is high enough to revive life that once existed within dimensional spaces.

"Revive."

Lin Yuan didn’t hesitate, starting to resurrect beings that had causal connections with him but had died or were as good as dead.

In an instant.

As far as Lin Yuan’s sight reached, a new secret realm was opened up.

Within the secret realm, a world was faintly forming, and the beings within quickly transformed from illusion to reality.

Lin Yuan’s first goal for resurrection was the time loop world he had experienced.

Time loop worlds were temporarily established by the Supreme Rule Dao, essentially indistinguishable from real life, with each person within having their own thoughts.

These belonged to lives that truly existed and could be revived by Lin Yuan.

Soon.

Accompanied by the beings of the world becoming entirely real.

The time that had stopped when Lin Yuan passed his test began to flow once again.

Unlike the time loop world Lin Yuan experienced, the resurrected beings of the time loop world no longer faced constraints of the Dao, allowing them to take more extraordinary paths.

"You are essentially creations by the Supreme Rule Dao, and I hope you can forge your own paths."

Lin Yuan gazed at the time loop world merged within the Chaos Void, thinking to himself silently.

Reviving the beings within the time loop world was because Lin Yuan couldn’t let them vanish just because he passed the test.

Even if those beings were also creations due to Lin Yuan’s trial.

Born because of Lin Yuan and perished because of Lin Yuan.

It sounded quite logical.

But since he became a time being, he naturally acted according to his heart.

If Lin Yuan thought it was unreasonable, then it was unreasonable.

...

After the beings of the time loop world were completely revived, not a single Entering Dao Master noticed anything unusual; they continued whatever they were doing as before.

Compared to Lin Yuan’s current life level, the beings in the time loop world were too weak.

"Cang Weiyang?"

Following a causal line, Lin Yuan looked towards the first pinnacle dominator he encountered upon emerging from the Chaos Void.

At that time, Cang Weiyang had perished exploring the ruins of a Void, and Lin Yuan had fortuitously discovered the cave left behind, where Cang Weiyang’s imprint voluntarily offered all the treasures to Lin Yuan.

The only request was hoping Lin Yuan could care for the Stone People tribe.

Lin Yuan eventually fulfilled this promise.

Now, being a time being, he casually resurrected this Twelfth Realm being too.

"I..."

In a Void Domain, the chubby ’Cang Weiyang’ looked around in confusion.
